description:
Task bay-ux2 — Clinic logo upload and app logo; clear WhatsApp reminders.

First read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agent-brief.md` in this worktree; run `npm.cmd ci` in `app/` first. Another worker is
polishing all forms and the window bar in parallel: touch only the files below and keep form markup changes minimal.

Product owner feedback (2026-11-04, real use of v0.3.0):
- "The clinic logo field in settings has no visible 'Logo yükle' button; only clicking the text opens the file picker.
  Offer a clearly visible upload button. When a clinic logo is uploaded, the app's logo should change to the clinic
  logo too."
- "In the reminder messages it is not clear how WhatsApp is connected or used. Make it clear and convenient how the user
  sends a reminder via WhatsApp."

Build:

1. **Clinic logo** (settings clinic card, `app/src/routes/settings/+page.svelte` logo block only): a preview tile
   (96 px, checkerboard-free neutral background, `object-contain`), a primary-secondary button "Logo yükle" (`Upload`
   icon) that opens the file picker, and when a logo exists "Değiştir" + "Kaldır". Drag and drop onto the tile also works.
   Keep the existing downscaling/size rules and the `clinic_logo` storage.
2. **App logo follows the clinic logo**: a small store `app/src/lib/branding.svelte.ts` loads `clinic_logo` (and
   `clinic_name`) at start and after the settings save. `app/src/lib/components/brand/Logo.svelte` renders the clinic
   logo image (rounded 22 %, `object-cover` in a square) when set, otherwise the Baytar paw mark. The window bar and
   sidebar wordmark show the clinic name instead of "Baytar" when set (keep "Baytar" in the window title suffix and in
   About). The lock screen and print documents use the same logo. Note: the taskbar/.exe icon cannot change at run time
   (that is the installed app icon); do not try.
3. **WhatsApp, explained and configurable**:
   - Setting `whatsapp_mode` (add to `KEYS` in `app/src-tauri/src/settings.rs`): `app` (WhatsApp Masaüstü uygulaması,
     opens `whatsapp://send?phone=<digits>&text=<urlencoded>`), `web` (opens `https://web.whatsapp.com/send?phone=…&text=…`
     in the browser), `auto` (default, `https://wa.me/<digits>?text=…`, which lets the system choose). Extend
     `open_whatsapp` to accept exactly these three URL prefixes (keep it strict; unit test each accepted and a few rejected
     URLs) and add the `opener` scheme permission if Tauri requires it for `whatsapp:`.
   - A shared `app/src/lib/whatsapp.ts` builds the URL from an E.164 phone + text for the selected mode; every place that
     opens WhatsApp (reminders, vaccines due list, billing receivables, home) uses it instead of building `wa.me` links.
   - Settings card "WhatsApp" (icon `MessageCircle`): a 3-option radio with a one-line explanation each, a short
     "Nasıl çalışır?" text: Baytar mesajı hazırlar ve WhatsApp'ı ilgili kişiyle açar; göndermek için WhatsApp'ta
     Gönder'e basarsınız; Baytar mesajı kendisi göndermez, hesap bağlamak gerekmez; WhatsApp Masaüstü kurulu değilse
     WhatsApp Web seçin. A "Deneme mesajı aç" button that opens a test message to the clinic phone (`clinic_phone`),
     disabled with a hint when no clinic phone is set.
   - Reminders page: a compact info strip under the header with the same 2-sentence explanation, the current mode and a
     "Ayarları değiştir" link; the message preview dialog's main button reads "WhatsApp'ta aç ve gönder" and the dialog
     says that the message opens in WhatsApp ready to send.
   - Rows without a phone: the WhatsApp button is replaced by "Telefon ekle" which opens the owner's edit form/page.

Verify: `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` (empty `app/build` if needed),
`cargo test --workspace`, `npm.cmd run check` (0 errors), `npm.cmd run build`. Report files changed and what each screen
shows.

Files you may change: `app/src/routes/settings/+page.svelte` (logo block and a new WhatsApp card only),
new `app/src/lib/branding.svelte.ts`, `app/src/lib/components/brand/Logo.svelte`, `app/src/lib/components/layout/TitleBar.svelte`
(wordmark text only — another worker changes its centre part; keep your diff to the wordmark), `app/src/routes/+layout.svelte`
(sidebar wordmark only), lock screen and print components (logo only), new `app/src/lib/whatsapp.ts`, the WhatsApp call
sites, `app/src/routes/reminders/+page.svelte`, `app/src/lib/components/reminders/*`, `app/src-tauri/src/settings.rs`,
`app/src-tauri/capabilities/default.json`, `app/src/lib/i18n/tr.ts` (append a block).

title: Ortak seçici, combobox, saat alanı, form düzeni, üst çubuk
description:
Task bay-ux1 — Shared selection and form components; window bar cleanup.

First read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agent-brief.md`, `docs/design-language.md` and `app/src/lib/components/ui/*` in this
worktree. Run `npm.cmd ci` in `app/` first. This task builds the shared pieces; a later task wires them into every
flow, so keep APIs clean and documented in a short comment at the top of each component.

Product owner feedback this answers (2026-11-04, real use of v0.3.0):
- "Input fields are too big while the labels above them are tiny; the visual hierarchy is broken. Use fitting icons:
  phone, e-mail, location for address, note for notes."
- "The asterisk on required fields is not explained. The form must say that * means required."
- "Picking a patient is only a search box. Show the owners as a list with a small arrow next to each; clicking it shows
  that owner's pets. Adapt to the number of records: with few owners and pets just list them directly, the user must
  not have to search or expand to choose among a handful."
- "I cannot type to search when choosing a vaccine from the catalog; I have to scroll the whole list. I want to type
  and see matching vaccines as I type."
- "Time field: clicking anywhere on it should open the picker directly; manual typing has problems. Use a better icon."
- "The top bar repeats the current page name, which is already in the sidebar and the page header. Remove it and make
  the search box wider."

Build:

1. **Form field polish** (`Input`, `Select`, `Textarea`, and the existing special inputs that wrap `Input`):
   - Labels: `text-sm font-medium text-fg` (today `type-caption`), 6 px gap to the control. Hints and errors stay small.
   - Controls: 40 px high (`min-h-10`), 14 px text, 12 px horizontal padding; textareas start at 3 rows.
   - Optional `icon` prop (a lucide component) rendered as a 16 px muted leading icon inside the control with left
     padding adjusted; focus ring unchanged. `PhoneInput` keeps its country button (no extra icon), `EmailInput`
     defaults to `Mail`.
   - New `RequiredNote.svelte`: one muted line "* ile işaretli alanlar zorunludur." Show it at the top of every form that
     has a required field (list below). Required labels render the asterisk in the danger colour with
     `aria-hidden="true"` (the input keeps `required`).
   - Apply to every form: OwnerForm (icons: name `User`, phone fields via PhoneInput, e-mail `Mail`, address `MapPin`,
     city/district `Building2`, national id `IdCard`, notes `StickyNote`), PatientForm (name `PawPrint`, breed `Dna`,
     colour `Palette`, microchip `ScanLine`, alerts `TriangleAlert`, notes `StickyNote`), VisitForm, AppointmentForm,
     VaccinationForm, PostponeForm, VaccineTypeForm, MedicationForm, HistoryRecordForm, ChargeForm, PaymentDialog,
     ServiceForm, ItemForm, StockForm, CatalogForm, settings clinic form, LockCard, TemplateEditor. Use sensible icons
     (calendar fields get none: the date input has its own).

2. **`Combobox.svelte`** (searchable select): props `items: {value: string|number; label: string; hint?: string;
   group?: string; disabled?: boolean}[]`, bindable `value`, `label`, `placeholder`, `required`, `error`, `icon`,
   optional `allowCustom` (typing a text that matches nothing offers "“<text>” olarak kullan"), optional `emptyText`.
   Behaviour: the field is a text input; focusing or clicking opens the list; typing filters with Turkish folding
   (`fold` like `app/src/lib/api/client.ts`: İ/I/ç/ğ/ı/ö/ş/ü) on label and hint; matched part bold; groups as small
   headers; ↑/↓/Enter/Escape/Tab; mouse; the list is capped at 300 px and scrolls; shows the selected label when closed;
   a small clear button. ARIA combobox pattern (`role="combobox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-activedescendant`, listbox
   options). Show it in `/design`.

3. **`RecordPicker.svelte`** (owner → pets tree), mode `'patient' | 'owner'`, bindable `selected` (`{owner, patient}` in
   patient mode, `{owner}` in owner mode), optional `allowCreate` (shows "Yeni sahip" / "Bu sahibe yeni hasta" actions
   that emit events `oncreateowner` / `oncreatepatient(owner)` for the parent to open forms), optional `excludeDeceased`
   (default true), optional `speciesFilter`.
   Data: add a core query `repo::search::directory(conn, query, limit)` returning owners (non-deleted) with ALL their
   non-deleted patients (not only matching ones), ordered by name; empty query = everyone up to `limit`; plus a total
   owner count. Tauri command `directory_list { query, limit }` → `{ total, owners: [{owner, patients}] }` in a new
   module `app/src-tauri/src/directory.rs` (only add `mod directory;` and one handler line to `lib.rs`). Unit tests for
   the query (deleted owners/pets excluded, folded matching on owner name, phone digits and pet name, all pets of a
   matching owner returned, limit and total).
   UI: a search field on top (optional, filters live with 150 ms debounce), then the list:
   - If total owners ≤ 12 and total pets ≤ 30 and no query: show every owner with its pets already expanded.
   - Otherwise owners are collapsed rows with a chevron (`ChevronRight` rotating to down) showing pet count and the
     phone; clicking the chevron or the row expands; with a query, matching owners auto-expand.
   - Pet rows: species icon, name, breed/age hint, warning icon if `alerts`, "Vefat" muted badge (hidden when
     `excludeDeceased`). Clicking a pet selects it (patient mode); in owner mode clicking the owner selects it.
   - Keyboard: ↑/↓ through visible rows, →/← expand/collapse, Enter selects.
   - Selected state collapses the picker into a summary card with "Değiştir".
   - Empty database: an empty state with "Yeni sahip ekle" (when `allowCreate`).
   - Browser dev mock: add the `directory_list` command to the mock (owners/patients arrays in `client.ts`).
   Show it in `/design` with mock data.

4. **`TimeInput.svelte`**: text field with a `Clock` icon; clicking or focusing anywhere opens a dropdown of times every
   15 minutes from 07:00 to 21:45 (scrolled to the current value or the next quarter hour), plus "Saat yok / tüm gün"
   when `optional`. Typing is masked and forgiving: `9` → `09:00`, `930` → `09:30`, `0930`, `9.30`, `9:3` → `09:30`,
   `21` → `21:00`; invalid on blur shows "Geçerli bir saat girin (SS:DD)". Binds `HH:MM` or `''`. Replace every
   `type="time"` input with it (AppointmentForm, HistoryRecordForm, VaccinationForm, VisitForm). Pure parsing function
   in `app/src/lib/validation.ts` with `node --test` cases.

5. **Window bar** (`app/src/lib/components/layout/TitleBar.svelte`): remove the page name/breadcrumb; keep logo + name on
   the left over the sidebar; the global search trigger becomes wider (up to 560 px, centred in the content area,
   shrinking on narrow windows); window buttons unchanged.

Verify: `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` (create an empty `app/build` dir first
if needed), `cargo test --workspace`, `npm.cmd run check` (0 errors), `npm.cmd run build`, the new `node --test` cases.
Report: files changed, component APIs, and a list of every form you touched.

Files you may change: `app/src/lib/components/ui/*`, new `app/src/lib/components/pickers/*`, the forms listed above,
`app/src/lib/components/layout/TitleBar.svelte`, `app/src/lib/validation*.ts`, `app/src/lib/api/{directory.ts,types.ts,client.ts}`,
`app/src/lib/i18n/tr.ts` (append a block), `app/src/routes/design/*`, `app/src/lib/components/DesignPreview.svelte`,
`crates/baytar-core/src/repo/search.rs`, new `app/src-tauri/src/directory.rs`, `app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs` (two lines),
`docs/design-language.md` (form rules).
Do not commit; the orchestrator commits as `feat(ui): record picker, combobox, time input and form polish` with `Refs: bay-ux1`.
acceptance_criteria: RecordPicker (az kayıtta açık liste, çok kayıtta oklu sahip listesi), Combobox (yazdıkça süzme), TimeInput (her yere tık açar), etiket/alan oranı, ikonlar, zorunlu alan notu, üst çubukta sayfa adı yok

title: Hesaplar: hizmet, ücret, tahsilat, alacaklar
description: docs/v2-plan.md §4 billing.
design:
Task bay-iqv.6 — Billing: services price list, charges, payments, owner accounts, receivables.

Context: Turkish freelance vets often work on credit ("veresiye"): the owner pays later. Paid practice software and
Turkish desktop programs all track this. Baytar must do it well, offline, simple. No e-invoice integration.

Build (v2-plan §4 row "billing"; tables `services`, `charges`, `payments` from schema v2):
1. Repos `crates/baytar-core/src/repo/{services,charges,payments,accounts}.rs`: CRUD + soft delete/restore; charge
   `total_minor = round(quantity * unit_price_minor) - discount_minor` computed in the repo (never trusted from input;
   discount <= gross); owner balance; owner statement (charges and payments merged by date with running balance);
   receivables list (owners with balance > 0, oldest unpaid charge date, last payment date) using FIFO allocation of
   payments to charges for the "oldest debt" age; daily summary (charges, collections per method) for a date range.
   Tests for rounding, discount bounds, balances with soft-deleted rows, FIFO age, statement order.
2. New nav item "Hesaplar" (icon `Wallet`) with tabs: **Alacaklar** (default: total receivable stat, list sorted by
   amount or age, orange amounts, WhatsApp reminder with a prefilled polite Turkish text including the amount),
   **Kasa** (date range, totals per payment method, list of payments and charges), **Hizmetler** (price list CRUD with
   MoneyInput and VAT %, active toggle; built-in services show a small "hazır" badge).
3. Owner page: account card (balance chip: green "Borcu yok" / orange "Borç ₺1.250,00"), "Tahsilat al" (primary when
   balance > 0) and "Ücret ekle" actions, statement view with running balance, delete/restore entries.
4. Visit form/page: "Ücretler" section to add charges to that visit from services (price prefilled), medicines/vaccines
   (price from `inventory_items.sale_price_minor` when an item links to it, else manual), or free text; quantity,
   discount; shows visit total and "Tahsil et" shortcut that opens the payment dialog prefilled with the visit total.
5. Payment dialog: amount (MoneyInput, default = balance), date, method (Nakit, Kart, Havale/EFT, Diğer), note.
   Overpayment allowed (credit shown as "Alacaklı" in turquoise).

Files: repos above + `repo/mod.rs`, new `app/src-tauri/src/billing.rs`, new `app/src/routes/accounts/*`, new
`app/src/lib/components/billing/*`, owner page `app/src/routes/patients/owner/+page.svelte` (add the account card;
keep other sections), visit form/page charge section, `app/src/lib/api/billing.ts`, mocks, `types.ts`, `tr.ts`,
`navigation.ts`, `format.ts` (formatMoney).

design:
Task bay-iqv.5 — Vaccines: give and plan vaccinations from the Vaccines page; schedules from the catalog.

Product owner: "The vaccine calendar looks good, but I cannot add a vaccine to an animal or plan one a few days ahead
from the Vaccines page. I must be able to do both there."

Build (v2-plan §4 row "vaccines"):
1. Vaccines page header actions: "Aşı uygula" (primary) and "Aşı planla" (secondary).
   - **Aşı uygula** dialog: patient picker (search by patient or owner name, shows species icon + owner), vaccine picker
     from the catalog filtered to the patient's species (plus species-null entries), date (default today), batch no,
     notes; "next due" auto-filled from the catalog (`default_interval_days`, or `primary_interval_days` while the
     patient has fewer than `primary_doses` doses of that vaccine) and editable. Optional "plan the next dose" checkbox
     (on by default) that creates the planned appointment for that date.
   - **Aşı planla** dialog: patient, vaccine, date (DateInput with quick chips "+1 hafta", "+2 hafta", "+1 ay",
     "+1 yıl"), optional time, notes -> appointment `kind = 'vaccine'`, `vaccine_type_id`, title "<vaccine> — <patient>".
2. **Upcoming / overdue** lists merge two sources: planned vaccine appointments and `next_due_on` of each patient's last
   dose of a vaccine that has no later dose or planned appointment. Deduplicate (a planned appointment wins). Each row:
   patient + owner, vaccine, due date with relative text ("3 gün sonra", "5 gün gecikti"), orange when overdue, actions
   "Uygulandı" (opens Aşı uygula prefilled; on save marks the appointment `done` and sets `vaccination_id`), "Ertele"
   (date chips), "WhatsApp" (existing open_whatsapp command with a prefilled Turkish reminder text).
   Filters: species, date range (bu hafta / bu ay / gecikenler), vaccine.
3. The month calendar on this page shows both given and planned vaccinations (different markers) and clicking a day
   opens "Aşı planla" for that date.
4. Patient page vaccines tab: same "Aşı uygula" / "Aşı planla" actions prefilled with the patient, and a schedule view
   per vaccine (given doses, next planned/due date, status chip: güncel / yaklaşıyor / gecikti / plan yok).
5. Backend: repository queries for the merged due list, a "give from appointment" operation that creates the vaccination,
   marks the appointment done and links them in ONE transaction, and catalog-aware next-due suggestion; tests for
   dedup, overdue, primary-series vs booster interval, and the transaction.

`app/src/lib/api/{vaccinations,appointments,vaccine_types}.ts`, mock files, `types.ts`, `tr.ts`.

design:
Task bay-iqv.4 — Input fields with validation, formatting and masks.

First read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agent-brief.md` and `docs/v2-plan.md` (section 4, row "inputs") in this worktree.
The product owner: "I can type as many digits as I want into the phone field. Use the modern phone inputs users know.
Default +90, other countries supported. Email and other fields need proper validation, formatting and masks."
Run `npm.cmd ci` in `app/` first (`libphonenumber-js` is already in package.json).

Build in `app/src/lib/components/ui/` (Svelte 5 runes, bindable `value`, `label`, `required`, `error` display, `id`

Task bay-iqv.3 — Built-in catalog of vaccines, medicines and services used in Turkish veterinary practice.

First read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agent-brief.md` and `docs/v2-plan.md` (sections 2 and 3 are your spec) in this worktree.
Another worker is writing migration `0002_v2.sql` in parallel; the columns you target are listed in v2-plan §2.

Deliverables:

1. `crates/baytar-core/catalog/vaccines.json`, `medications.json`, `services.json`. Each file:
   `{"version": 1, "sources": [ {"id": "...", "title": "...", "url": "..."} ], "items": [ ... ]}`.
   Each item carries the target column names from v2-plan §2 (snake_case) plus `"source_ids": [...]`.
   - **Vaccines (~40)**: dogs (combined DHPPi, DHPPi+L, L4, rabies, kennel cough/bronchiseptica, coronavirus,
     leishmania), cats (FVRCP / RCP, RCPCh, FeLV, rabies), rabbits (RHD1/2, myxomatosis), ferret distemper, and food
     animals (foot-and-mouth/şap, brucellosis S19 and Rev-1, sheep pox, goat pox, PPR, enterotoxaemia/clostridial,
     lumpy skin disease, anthrax, IBR/BVD, theileriosis, bluetongue). Use product names sold in Turkey where you are
     confident (e.g. Nobivac, Vanguard, Eurican, Biocan, Rabisin, Purevax, Felocell, Versifel, Leucofeligen) and also
     generic entries ("Karma aşı (köpek)", "Kuduz aşısı"). Fields: `name` (Turkish display name, brand + type),
     `species` (one value from v2-plan species list, or null for multi-species), `manufacturer`, `diseases`
     (Turkish, comma separated), `min_age_weeks`, `primary_doses`, `primary_interval_days`, `default_interval_days`
     (booster), `notes` (Turkish, short).
   - **Medicines (~120)** across the v2-plan categories, companion and food animals. Fields: `name` (brand as sold in
     Turkey, or generic), `active_ingredient`, `category`, `form` (v1 enum: tablet, capsule, injection, suspension,
     drops, ointment, other), `concentration_mg_per_ml`, `strength_mg_per_unit`, `dose_mg_per_kg_min`,
     `dose_mg_per_kg_max`, `route` (Turkish: "Ağız yoluyla", "Deri altı", "Kas içi", "Damar içi", "Haricen", ...),
     `target_species` (Turkish display text), `manufacturer`, `prescription_required`, `withdrawal_note` (food-animal
     products only), `pack_unit`, `notes`.
   - **Services (~25)** without prices: `name`, `category` (v2-plan list), `notes`.
   **Accuracy rule:** this goes in front of vets. Only fill a numeric value (dose range, concentration, interval) when it
   is the standard label/textbook value you are confident of; otherwise null. Never invent brands. Prefer EMA product
   information (medicines.health.europa.eu), manufacturer pages, Plumb's-style standard ranges and Turkish ministry
   pages as sources; you have network access (`curl`) if you want to check a value. Every item lists its sources.

2. `tools/catalog/build.py` (Python 3 stdlib only): validates the JSON (required fields, enums from v2-plan, min <= max,
   positive numbers, unique lower(name) per file) and writes `crates/baytar-core/src/db/migrations/0003_catalog_seed.sql`.
   The SQL inserts each row with `is_builtin = 1` using `INSERT INTO ... SELECT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t
   WHERE lower(name) = lower(?) AND deleted_at IS NULL)`, with properly escaped string literals. Header comment: generated,
   do not edit by hand. Deterministic output (stable order). Do not register the migration in `db/mod.rs`; the
   orchestrator does that after schema v2 merges.

3. `tools/catalog/README.md`: how to edit the data and regenerate; the accuracy rule.

Verify: run `py -3 tools/catalog/build.py` twice (output identical). Then prove the SQL runs: in a scratch Python script,
create an in-memory SQLite DB from `crates/baytar-core/src/db/migrations/0001_init.sql`, then add the v2 columns and the
`services` table exactly as v2-plan §2 lists them (just enough ALTER/CREATE for the seed), run the seed twice, and check
row counts are unchanged after the second run. Put that check in `tools/catalog/check_seed.py`. Report final counts per
file and how many numeric fields you left null.

Files you may change: `crates/baytar-core/catalog/*` (new), `tools/catalog/*` (new),
`crates/baytar-core/src/db/migrations/0003_catalog_seed.sql` (new, generated).
Do not commit; the orchestrator commits as `feat(catalog): built-in vaccines, medicines and services` with `Refs: bay-iqv.3`.

Task bay-iqv.10 — Reminders centre.

Build (v2-plan §4 row "reminders"):
1. New nav item "Hatırlatmalar" (icon `BellRing`), placed after "Ajanda" in `app/src/lib/navigation.ts`.
2. Page `app/src/routes/reminders/+page.svelte` with sections (cards with icon chips and count badges):
   - **Aşılar**: overdue and due within N days (default 7, selector 3/7/14/30) from the existing merged due list
     (`vaccinations` repo / `vaccines_due_list` command). Deceased patients never appear.
   - **Randevular**: tomorrow's planned appointments (and today's not yet done).
   - **Borçlar**: owners with a positive balance older than N days (default 30) from the billing receivables command.
   - **Kontroller**: visits whose patient has a planned follow-up appointment of kind `visit` within N days.
   Each row: owner + patient, reason, date with relative text, phone, actions "WhatsApp" (opens the existing
   `open_whatsapp` command with a filled template) and "Arandı / Mesaj atıldı" (marks contacted).
3. **Contact log**: new migration `0004_reminders.sql` with table `reminder_contacts` (STRICT, id, `kind` CHECK
   (`vaccine, appointment, debt, followup`), `ref_key TEXT NOT NULL` (stable key such as `vaccine:<patientId>:<vaccineTypeId>:<dueOn>`,
   `appointment:<id>`, `debt:<ownerId>:<YYYY-MM-DD of oldest unpaid>`), `owner_id FK`, `channel` CHECK (`whatsapp, phone, other`),
   `contacted_at` UTC text, `note`), index on `ref_key`. Register it in `crates/baytar-core/src/db/mod.rs` as version 4
   "reminders". Repo `crates/baytar-core/src/repo/reminders.rs`: record contact, last contact per ref_key. Rows contacted
   today show a muted "Bugün iletildi" chip and move to the bottom; a filter hides them.

title: İsteğe bağlı uygulama kilidi (PIN)
description: docs/v2-plan.md §4 lock.
design:
Task bay-iqv.13 — Optional app lock (PIN).

Build (v2-plan §4 row "lock"): off by default.
1. Rust: `argon2` crate (add to `app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml` or core) — commands `lock_status` (enabled, idle minutes),
   `lock_set_pin(pin)` (4-8 digits, stores an argon2id PHC string in settings key `lock_pin_hash`; never store or log the
   PIN), `lock_disable(pin)`, `lock_verify(pin)` (constant-time via argon2 verify; after 5 wrong attempts enforce a
   30 s wait in the Rust state, doubling up to 5 minutes), `lock_set_idle(minutes)` (0 = never, 1-240) in `lock_idle_minutes`.
   These keys are NOT exposed through the generic `settings_get_all/settings_set` (keep them out of `KEYS`).
2. Frontend: settings card "Uygulama kilidi" (toggle, set/change PIN with confirm, idle minutes select: Kapalı, 5, 10,
   15, 30, 60). Lock screen overlay component mounted in `app/src/routes/+layout.svelte`: shown at start when enabled and
   after the idle timeout (pointer/keyboard activity resets the timer; also lock when the window is minimised for longer
   than the timeout), PIN pad with keyboard input, masked dots, error shake, wait countdown, logo and "Baytar kilitli".
   While locked the app content is not rendered (not just covered) so it cannot be read via devtools-free means.
   A "PIN'imi unuttum" link shows a short help text: the lock protects against casual access at a shared computer;
   a forgotten PIN is removed with the command `baytar-cli unlock --data <dir>`, which you add to `crates/baytar-cli`
   (it deletes `lock_pin_hash` after a confirmation prompt; records are not touched).
3. Tests: Rust unit tests for hash/verify, length validation, backoff timing logic (inject a clock); CLI unlock test.

Files: `app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml`, new `app/src-tauri/src/lock.rs`, `lib.rs` (mod + handlers), `crates/baytar-cli/*`,
`app/src/routes/+layout.svelte` (mount only), new `app/src/lib/components/lock/*`, settings page (one card), API/mock,
`types.ts`, `tr.ts`.
Commit message (orchestrator): `feat(lock): optional PIN lock with idle timeout` + `Refs: bay-iqv.13`.

First read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agent-brief.md`, `docs/v2-plan.md` and `docs/data-model.md` (schema v2 is merged) in this
worktree; follow them. Run `npm.cmd ci` in `app/` before any npm command.

Shared rules for v2 feature work:
- **Backend**: repository functions in `crates/baytar-core/src/repo/<area>.rs` (pattern of the existing repos: validation,
  soft delete + restore, `updated_at`, errors via the core error type), unit tests next to them. Tauri commands in a NEW
  module file `app/src-tauri/src/<area>.rs` (do not move existing commands); in `app/src-tauri/src/lib.rs` only add your
  `mod <area>;` line and your entries to `generate_handler!` (other workers add theirs in parallel; keep your lines
  together at the end of the list).
- **Frontend API**: `app/src/lib/api/<area>.ts` using `call(...)`, types appended to `app/src/lib/api/types.ts`
  (`CommandMap` entries too). The browser dev mock must support your commands with a few synthetic rows so the
  orchestrator can review the screens in a browser: put mock handlers in `app/src/lib/api/<area>-mock.ts` and hook them
  into the mock dispatch in `client.ts` with a minimal change.
- **UI**: use the v2 design system: `PageHeader` (page title + subtitle + turquoise primary action), `Card` with header
  icon chips (turquoise for clinical, orange for money/stock/warnings), `StatTile`, `Badge`, `Button` variants, and the
  validated inputs (`PhoneInput`, `MoneyInput`, `NumberInput`, `DateInput`, `EmailInput`). Look at `/design` and the
  existing pages first. Empty states with a clear next action. Keyboard friendly dialogs. Money via a `formatMoney`
  helper in `app/src/lib/format.ts` (tr-TR, ₺, minor units) if it does not exist yet.
- Turkish UI text in `app/src/lib/i18n/tr.ts` (append your own block at the end; do not reorder others' keys).
  New nav entries go to `app/src/lib/navigation.ts`.
- Verify before reporting: `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`,
  `cargo test --workspace`, `npm.cmd run check` (0 errors) and `npm.cmd run build` in `app/`. You cannot see the UI:
  in your report, list each screen/dialog you built and what it shows so the orchestrator can review it.

Do not commit; the orchestrator commits with the message above.
